name: La Sicilia
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Sicily in Mittenwald

** Experience the magic of **Sicily** right in the heart of the **Alps**—in **Mittenwald**, the charming village in **Tirol**. Here, the sun-kissed flavors of the Mediterranean meet the crisp mountain air of the **Karwendel** and **Zugspitze** regions. Our **Sicilian-inspired** menu brings you authentic tastes from the island: golden **Arancini**, spicy **Pasta alla Norma**, and fragrant **Cannoli**—all made with love by our chefs. Pair your meal with a glass of **Nero d’Avola** or a refreshing **Almond Milk** from the **Alps**. In the evening, enjoy **Sicilian music** and dance under the stars, as if you were in **Palermo** or **Taormina**. And don’t miss our **Limoncello**—just like Nonna used to make it! Whether you're here for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a culinary adventure, **Mittenwald** offers a taste of **Sicily** like no other. **Mangia, bevi, e goditi!** *(Eat, drink, and enjoy!)*
